window.explanation: Crop a georeferenced raster and choose a new grid shape while preserving the selected extent, CRS, band units and nodata. Useful for bounded GIS elevation, temperature and categorical grid subsets.
pitfalls: Nearest downsampling loses unsampled pixels and is not an average.
CRS assertion never reprojects coordinates; EPSG:4326 raster axes are longitude then latitude.

examples.purpose: Extract a nodata-aware elevation window with independently checked pixels.

fields.explanation: Extract a raster pixel window and optionally resize its grid. All fields are required so source metadata and sampling intent remain explicit; no reprojection or arbitrary native flags.

/properties/version.explanation: Use schemaxis.gdal/1 for this document contract. The native GDAL 3.13.3 runtime version is checked separately.

/properties/operation.explanation: Choose window to crop by source pixel coordinates and nearest-neighbour resize without changing the window extent.

/properties/source.explanation: Absolute local .tif/.tiff regular file, at most 8 MiB and 262144 pixels. Single-band north-up uncompressed strips only, no symlink/device/remote input. Source bytes are captured; changes invalidate reuse.

/properties/x.explanation: Zero-based leftmost source column, in pixels, from the upper-left corner. The window must remain fully inside the source; no padded pixels.

/properties/y.explanation: Zero-based topmost source row, in pixels, increasing downward. It is not a northing; north-up grids have negative geotransform y spacing.

/properties/width.explanation: Number of source columns to retain,1–4096 pixels. Together with height at most 262144; x+width must fit the source.

/properties/height.explanation: Number of source rows to retain,1–4096 pixels. Together with width at most 262144; y+height must fit the source.

/properties/outputWidth.explanation: Number of columns on the output grid,1–4096, at most 262144 output pixels. Equal to width retains horizontal spacing; a changed count preserves extent and changes pixel width.

/properties/outputHeight.explanation: Number of rows on the output grid,1–4096, at most 262144 output pixels. Equal to height retains vertical spacing; a changed count preserves extent and negative y spacing.

/properties/epsg.explanation: Required assertion of source CRS, 4326 or 3857. 4326 raster coordinates are x longitude and y latitude in degrees; 3857 uses easting/northing metres. A mismatch is refused; this field does not reproject.

/properties/units.explanation: Required assertion of band value units: m for metres, K for kelvin, 1 for dimensionless. Distinct from horizontal CRS units. Source units must match and output units are preserved, without vertical-datum inference.

/properties/nodata.explanation: Required finite source nodata sentinel. Must match the tag and fit the source dtype exactly. Nearest sampling copies a nodata pixel unchanged; statistics exclude it and use null extrema/mean when every pixel is nodata.

/properties/resampling.explanation: Only nearest is supported. Output centres select source indices floor((2*i+1)*sourceSize/(2*outputSize)); ties select the higher index. No averaging or conservation; bilinear is deliberately refused.

/properties/lossPolicy.explanation: Choose strict to refuse unsupported bands, masks, overviews, compression or metadata. Only TIFF strip layout, byte order and descriptive CRS citations may change; no silent semantic metadata loss.
